authenticationFlows.description: Customer sign-in with Levels of Authentication: acr 1 password, acr 2 password plus WebAuthn or TOTP (step-up with acr_values=2)
acr 2: a second factor (asked again after the level-2 max age)
WebAuthn (2FA), passkey or TOTP authenticator app
Staff sign-in (console, developer portal): password plus a second factor (acr 2); WebAuthn security key or TOTP authenticator app, enrolment forced on first sign-in
acr 2: a second factor (asked again after the level-2 max age)
WebAuthn security key when registered, otherwise the TOTP app
WebAuthn (2FA) for users who registered a security key
TOTP for everyone else (set-up forced when missing)
